profile.headline: Software Engineer at Raytheon
profile.summary:
I currently work at Raytheon Technologies in Fort Wayne, IN as a software engineer. 

I graduated from the University of Texas Rio Grande Valley in Spring 2018, ranked number 1 out of a class of over 200 with a 4.0 institutional GPA.  

I have interned at the Air Force Research Lab working on fuze systems for hard-target penetrators. During my time there I designed, fabricated, and tested an experimental sensor array capable of detecting movement of explosive material within a penetrator, during impact. I also mounted and tested various accelerometers using a Hopkinson's bar. I believe that I would be a great fit for a defense contractor or government research institution, as this would tie together my research experience, military background, and personal interest. However, I am very open to nearly every area of electrical engineering, and I am a very fast learner. 

My area of interest is very broad, but I consider my greatest technical strengths to be circuit design, digital systems, and embedded systems. I also have a firm grasp of C++ and am very experienced with MATLAB. I am hard-working, self-motivated, and team-oriented.

positions.title: Aircraft Mechanic
positions.description: I would prefer not to list specific details of my enlistment online.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
•	Conducted a variety of tasks including designing and performing electrical and mechanical evaluation tests of shock-hardened sensors, material characterization for shock mitigation, and assisting with laboratory tasks such as the assembly of new experimental testing capabilities.
•	Spearheaded the design and fabrication of a sensor array capable of detecting the displacement of explosive material within the munition during impact; also wrote MATLAB scripts which imported and analyzed the data generated by the sensors
•	Communicated the results of my research through a general poster session as well as multiple department briefings.

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented networking and camera systems for commercial and domestic purposes
•	Performed computer maintenance and troubleshooting, installed and service a variety of software including security programs, operating systems, server-dependent applications, and basic programs
